title: Alcohol & Drunkenness
summary: Drunkenness is forbidden; Christian liberty is governed by wisdom and love.
context: Paul contrasts drunkenness with Spirit-filled living.

title: Marriage
summary: Marriage calls for covenant faithfulness and sacrificial love.
context: Jesus appeals to creation when discussing marriage.

title: Anxiety
summary: Bring worries to God in prayer and trust his care.
context: These passages encourage trust, not shame for experiencing anxiety.

title: Forgiveness
summary: Christians are called to forgive as they have been forgiven.
context: Forgiveness does not necessarily remove consequences or require unsafe reconciliation.

title: Salvation
summary: Salvation is by grace through faith, not earned by works.
context: Good works are the fruit of salvation.

title: Money & Wealth
summary: Wealth is not ultimate security; practice generosity and contentment.
context: The love of money, rather than money itself, is condemned.

title: Suffering
summary: Believers can trust God amid suffering without denying its pain.
context: Christian hope does not promise immediate relief.

title: Judgment
summary: Avoid hypocritical judgment while practicing righteous discernment.

title: Philippians 4:13
summary: Christ strengthens Paul to endure changing circumstances, not to achieve every ambition.
context: Often treated as a promise of unlimited achievement; the context is contentment.

title: Matthew 7:1
summary: Jesus condemns hypocritical judgment, not every moral assessment.
context: Verse 5 calls for self-examination before helping another.

title: Jeremiah 29:11
summary: God promises a future to the exiled community, not immediate individual prosperity.
context: The promise addresses Judah in exile over a long period.

title: Matthew 18:20
summary: Jesus promises his presence in the context of communal accountability and prayer.
context: The passage does not imply Christ is absent when a believer prays alone.

title: Romans 8:28
summary: God works for the good of his people, including conformity to Christ.
context: The good is not a guarantee of comfortable circumstances.
